definition: fried, salty or sugary snacks that are unhealthy
description: At night a young man in a brown beanie, olive puffer jacket and hoodie with a lanyard sits on a low wall beside a lit takeaway van. He holds a handful of chips over a greasy paper wrapper of chips, ketchup and a battered sausage on his lap and eats them. He turns to look at a seagull that stands on the wall beside him, drinks from a can and smiles. A cheeseburger in paper sits next to him on the wall, steam rises from the van's fryer and orange street lights shine on the wet pavement behind.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er macht sich über fettige Pommes her.
